data.description: The target firearm suddenly fires of its own volition, even if it is unloaded, generating a recoil so great that the wielder or carrier of the firearm must scramble to hold onto it and becomes flat-footed until the start of his next turn. If the wielder is already flat-footed, he is instead knocked prone. If the firearm was loaded, that ammunition is wasted.

raw_tokens.value: Ammunition in the targeted firearm generates excessive recoil.|!PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
